responsibility: This implementation module provides lightweight debugging output for gm2 libraries by formatting location-tagged halt messages and writing escaped strings character-by-character through StdIO. It converts line numbers with NumberIO, interprets sequences such as \n and \\, emits CR/LF line endings explicitly, and then halts, making it a simple diagnostic helper distinct from the broader runtime termination and exception machinery in M2RTS and RTExceptions.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Debug pair: unlike Debug.def, which only declares the debugging API, this file imports ASCII, NumberIO, and StdIO and implements message formatting, \n and \\ escape handling, CR/LF emission, and HALT.
